remarks: Tucked away on a coveted Westport lane, 3 Stonewall Ln. offers an exceptional blend of sophistication and modern comfort. This expansive 5-bedroom residence features 5 full baths and four full floors of beautifully finished living space, providing unparalleled flexibility for both grand entertaining and seamless work-from-home living. The home's impressive proportions are evident throughout, with generously sized rooms, soaring 10ft ceilings, and an effortless flow. Front and back staircases enhance both functionality and flow, ideal for everyday living. A finished walkout basement includes an additional room with a full bath, perfect for guests, an au pair, a gym, or a private office suite. Step outside to your backyard retreat, where a stunning pool with an automatic cover and built-in spa takes center stage. This resort-style setting is ideal for relaxing, entertaining, and extending your living space outdoors year-round.
